mathematics.assertion_tested: Actual terminal-reset Padé models have integral denominator coefficients, matched moments through degree 2d-1, exact first omitted moment valuation 1, exact source and derivative errors, and exact stationary motion for the two previously fixed ordinary indices.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact Python integers and fractions.Fraction, with proved finite dyadic precision and complete local polynomial truncation.
non_claims: No universal Euler critical nonvanishing theorem.
The all-rank carry theorem is proved algebraically, not exhaustively checked.
No extension of the rank1..10 source-error formula to arbitrarily large rank.
No transfer of kernel rationality to rationality in the stationary coordinate.
No claim that a nonzero moment determinant excludes a zero critical value.
No new ordinary indices or multiplier digits, and no Lean compilation.
